daemon_path.description: Full path to the LCDd executable.

daemon_name.description: Name of the daemon process (used in logging/status).

daemon_opts.description: Command-line options passed to the LCDd binary via the init script. '-s 1' enables single-process mode, '-f' forces foreground execution (overridden by stop-start-daemon), '-c /etc/LCDd.conf' specifies the config file.
